records.displayedAlt: Six stylized chromosomes labelled A to F, arranged in a deliberately mixed order. Their lengths, horizontal dark-and-light band patterns and centromere constriction positions can be compared to form three pairs. A and D are long with an approximately central centromere and two upper bands and one lower band; B and F are shorter with centromere near the top and one upper band and two lower bands; C and E are medium-sized with a central centromere and one upper band and two lower bands. This is a constructed teaching drawing, not a microscope image or measured karyogram.
